derivation: For normalized product Haar measure, on an even periodic bipartite box take even angles in (-eta,eta) and odd angles in (epsilon-3eta,epsilon-eta). This admissible product set has measure (eta/pi)^V and C/V <= D*cos(epsilon-4eta). Since kappa<0, Z >= (eta/pi)^V*exp(kappa*DV*cos(epsilon-4eta)). On C/(DV)>=c, exp(kappa*C)<=exp(kappa*DV*c); its Haar measure is at most1. Therefore P(event)<=min(1,exp(V*(log(pi/eta)+D*kappa*(c-cos(epsilon-4eta))))).
scope: Exact instantaneous equilibrium configuration-event bound, not a bound on a trajectory mean, not a relaxation-time estimate and not evidence that the complementary sampled sector has equilibrated or ordered. Observed frame fractions are descriptive correlated trajectory frequencies. Persistent high-event occupancy identifies nonequilibrium sampling at these parameters.
